title: אגרת מס׳ 872 — מענה בעניין מצב רפואי וביטחון בה׳
summary_researcher: The published page identifies this as Letter No. 872, dated 23 Teves 5711, to an unnamed recipient. The letter explicitly says it responds to a letter from Thursday of Parshas Vayechi reporting several operations. The incoming letter itself is not reproduced. Letter No. 937 later contains an editorial cross-reference to Letter No. 872 and its cited sources in connection with the Chabad maxim 'Tracht gut, vet zain gut'.
